title: Northgate Card Product Changes, Secured Graduation and Credit Line Review Terms
content:
**Graduation.** A Northgate Secured Card account of **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** is reviewed for graduation to a Northgate Store Card once its count of on-time cycles reaches the card's graduation review cycles. The count of on-time cycles is the number of consecutive statements, counted backwards from the most recent statement whose payment due date has passed, for which payments credited by the payment due date reached the minimum payment due. On graduation the limit is at least the deposit and the deposit is refunded under the account standing rules.

**Other product changes.** Other product changes move between tiers of the same customer type and are decided by the issuer.

**Credit line increase requests.** A requested credit line increase is considered only when the account has been open at least the tier's credit line review months. Calendar months are added to the opened date, falling back to the last day of a shorter month, and a request on that date qualifies. The opened date is read from the system record of the card account. A further request is considered no sooner than the same number of months after the last limit change.

| Request date on a 6-month review card (hypothetical opened date: the 31st of a month) | Considered |
|---|---|
| the day before the date six calendar months after opening | no |
| six calendar months after opening, falling on the last day of a shorter month (for instance the 30th) | yes |
| any later date | yes |

**Active status.** A product change or limit change can be made only on an account in active status, as the system record of the card account shows it.

**Over the limit.** A limit decrease below the current balance never creates an over-limit fee, because the card's over-the-limit fee applies, and transactions above the limit are declined.

**Authorized users and replacement cards.** An account may carry up to the card's maximum authorized users, and a replacement card costs the card's replacement card fee.
